faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Rishikesh Project Technical Support III recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form for the AIIMS Rishikesh Project Technical Support III recruitment is 30th July 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Technical Support III post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have a three-year Graduation in a relevant subject/field with three years of experience, or a Post Graduation in a relevant subject/field, or a First Class Four Years Graduate Degree with Three Years Experience to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Technical Support III position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Technical Support III position is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms and regulations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support III post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Technical Support III post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30800 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the AIIMS Rishikesh Project Technical Support III recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out, attach necessary documents, and send it to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided data, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Technical Support III role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Technical Support III role will involve a Screening Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The job type for the Project Technical Support III post is contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where is AIIMS Rishikesh located?
faq.answer: AIIMS Rishikesh is located in Rishikesh, Uttarakhand.
